Summary

The Gate of the Farl Gods Matt DInniman DCC #4

Essentially the main thing that happened at the end that has the biggest influence on the next book was Kati’s discussed leaving the party. Then Carl opened the gate and flooded the city of larracos on the 9th floor which made a lot of people mad. They teased the bea and Ferdinand would be brought into the game.

Maggie Mai is dead, Rock Man Chris has joined the party temporarily. They have hired a Demigod/Feral God imprisoned in the head of a sex doll as their new trainer. Carl is using the Anarchist Cookbook as a guide to attack the MudSkippers. Carl has killed 1 admin and gotten away with it. Carl's second sponsor is REALLY wealthy and investing big on him. There was a epilogue conversation within this group implying that thier real purpose is in line with Carl's. The next floor is the first with outsiders coming en masse to hunt crawlers, and Carl finished the book taunting them all.
